gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Modern and fairly tall in the lowercase, with terminals cut back to leave a generous gap. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi would look blunt if Eater were shrunk down small, since that dark heading's wide gaps need size to feel menacing.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Noto Sans Gurmukhi reads crisp and businesslike, its terminals flaring outward like tongs. Eater stays moody above it, and the plain sans keeps a long stretch of text moving without any fuss or friction.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Eater's thin strokes sit beside sturdier stems, giving it a dark, jagged bite. Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line height with open terminals, so the text underneath feels easy and contemporary against that heading.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Dark, gappy and a bit menacing, Eater shows slight thick-thin variation in its strokes. Noto Sans Hebrew handles the other job, a tall midsection and wide curve openings that make a plain sans easy to read.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK has large lowercase forms and tight ascender clearance. Eater brings the aggressive, wide-spaced bite up top, while the plain sans below stays clean and businesslike with lifted brush ends.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aramaic: Sharp, spiky and a little menacing up top. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic gives the strongest quality here, an approachable sans whose c opens like pincers against Eater's sturdy hairlines.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional-par: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian has big open eyes on every e and a, over a deep middle band. Eater does the dark, crayon-rough shouting, and the plain sans does the quiet, tidy explaining.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-jp: Eater is dark and aggressive, with a medium amount of weight shifting along each stroke. Noto Sans JP does the opposite job, offering a very tall x-height and sweeping sans-serif curves.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Eater's wide letter gaps and thin strokes give it a rough, ominous look. Noto Sans Kaithi follows with lowercase that fills the line like capitals, and Eater earns its keep when big and short.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Approachable is the first thing Noto Sans Kannada says, with a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals. And Eater stays dark and rough above, while this sans-serif keeps a long page of text flowing smoothly.
